cards.t: MSCI Rules Target Strategy for Index Removal
cards.b: MSCI finalized rules classifying non-operating companies with balance sheets dominated by a single asset as ineligible, targeting firms like Bitcoin treasury giant Strategy starting November 30.

per.BTC: Potential index removal for Strategy could trigger balance sheet and treasury pressures.
